p.title: Home KPI trend included a row after the close basis and disagreed with 시장 상태
p.symptom: The 10-year yield '20거래일' change read +45bp (2026-09-09 to 10-08) on the home and +47bp (09-08 to 10-07) on 시장 상태.
p.root_cause: trendPoints called buildCloseSeries without the common close basis, so a pre-market row dated after the S&P 500's last completed close (10-08, observed 09:16 ET) entered the home series; 시장 상태 passes through: basis.
p.fix: trendPoints stops at closeBasis(history), like the other screen.
p.violated_rule: One quantity, one definition across screens (H03).
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check P1527: the home series equals the 시장 상태 series and has no point after the basis; the mutation that drops the basis fails it.
p.verification: Replayed on public-data/history.json: before +45bp, after +47bp equal to 시장 상태; S&P 500, Nasdaq and WTI series identical on both. Not verified: browser rendering.

changelog: **홈 추이의 종가 기준 통일 (P{P}):** 홈 KPI 추이가 종가 기준일 이후 행을 포함해 10년물 20거래일이 +45bp로 보이던 것을 시장 상태와 같은 +47bp로 맞췄다(H03).
